children: Zscaler Chief Executive Officer Jay Chaudhry said AI is increasing demand for cybersecurity rather than reducing the need for software security, according to Bloomberg.

He said CEOs, CIOs and boards want to use AI for productivity and cost savings, but worry new AI models could create vulnerabilities, lead to breaches or leave applications exposed to hacking or hijacking.

title: AI Boosts Cybersecurity Demand at Zscaler, Jay Chaudhry Says
